name: dsh-webui-switch
description: Start, report, and stop the local Web profile from the Desktop app: one header control that boots the WebUI windowless in the background, shows whether it is serving, and stops it - terminating the profile it started, or a console Ctrl+C first for one you started yourself in a terminal.
author: ZhaoAndy821 (https://github.com/ZhaoAndy821)

scripts.test: node test/smoke.mjs && node test/host.mjs && node test/client.mjs && node test/journal.mjs
